newsitem.title: GERMANY: G7 deputies meet in Frankfurt to prepare G7 agenda.
newsitem.headline: G7 deputies meet in Frankfurt to prepare G7 agenda.

text.p: Deputy finance ministers for the Group of Seven nations are meeting in Frankfurt on Monday preparing an agenda for this weekend's G7 meeting in Berlin, a U.S. government official said.
The official said the meeting, to be attended by U.S. deputy Treasury secretary Lawrence Summers and German state secretary to the Finance Ministry Juergen Stark, would be held at the Bundesbank.
The Bundesbank was not immediately able to confirm that the meeting was taking place.
Monetary sources has said on Friday that the deputies were expected to discuss the dollar's recent steep rise and the state of world economy.
The G7 is comprised of Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States.
